article.title: Russian attacks on Kharkiv Oblast leave 15 people injured, including two children
article.summary: Russian forces have attacked Kharkiv and 17 settlements in Kharkiv Oblast over the course of 20 November. The attacks left 15 people injured, including two children.

article.title: Russian attacks kill at least 2, injure 83 across Ukraine, as strikes devastate Kryvyi Rih
article.summary: Overnight on Nov. 21, Russia launched three Iskander-M/KN-23/S-400 ballistic missiles and 148 drones, including 87 jet-powered drones, according to Ukraine's Air Force.

article.title: Russian ship ‘carrying war supplies’ engulfed in flames after drone blitz near Finland as Zelensky blasts ‘killer’ Putin
article.summary: A RUSSIAN ship reportedly carrying military supplies was engulfed in flames after a mystery drone blitz near Finland - after Zelensky branded Putin a "killer".

article.title: Russia says cargo vessel struck by drones, Finland says it is on fire in its waters
article.summary: MOSCOW, Nov 21 - Russian officials said on Saturday that a cargo vessel bound for Kaliningrad was attacked by two drones in neutral waters in the Gulf of Finland, three nautical miles from Russia's border.

article.title: Russia Says Cargo Vessel Struck by Drones in Gulf of Finland
article.summary: Finland said that the damaged vessel was on fire and had drifted from international waters into its territorial waters.

article.title: Ukraine’s air defenses down 82 missiles, 380 Russian drones overnight
article.summary: Ukraine's air defenses neutralized 82 missiles and 380 drones launched by Russian forces in an attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20. Russian strikes were recorded at 23 locations.

article.title: Russia launches up to 100 missiles at Ukraine, one may have crossed into Poland – Ignat
article.summary: During a combined attack on Ukraine overnight on November 20, Russia launched up to 100 missiles, one of which may have crossed into Polish airspace.

article.title: Russians attack Kryvyi Rih again, striking industrial facility
article.summary: A jet-powered Russian drone struck an industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih overnight, causing a fire. The attack followed a ballistic missile strike that killed two people and injured 47 others.

article.title: Russia says cargo vessel struck by drones, Finland says it is on fire in its waters - Reuters
article.summary: Russia says cargo vessel struck by drones, Finland says it is on fire in its watersReuters

article.title: Air defense neutralizes 117 of 148 Russian drones launched against Ukraine overnight
article.summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 117 of the 148 drones launched by Russian forces against Ukraine since the evening of November 20.

article.title: Kyiv reports damage in three districts after morning Russian attack, two people injured
article.summary: Two people were injured in a Russian attack on Kyiv in the morning of November 21. Residential buildings were damaged in three districts, while water supply disruptions were reported in five districts.

article.title: Injury toll in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih rises to 60
article.summary: The number of people injured in Russian attacks on Kryvyi Rih has risen to 60, with 28 people remaining in hospital.

article.title: Russia launches up to 200 attack drones nightly and more than 100 during the day – Ihnat
article.summary: Russian forces are attacking Ukraine with strike drones virtually around the clock, launching more than 100 during the day and up to 200 at night. On some days, jet-powered UAVs account for as much as 95% of the total.

article.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, hits recorded at 19 locations
article.summary: Russia launched three ballistic missiles and 148 drones, including 87 jet-powered UAVs, against Ukraine overnight. Strikes were recorded at 19 locations, with the attack still ongoing as of the morning of 21 November.

article.title: Russian ship 'attacked by drones in neutral waters' just three miles from border as crew evacuated
article.summary: A Russian ship has been attacked by drones in neutral waters just three miles from its border as the vessel's crew is evacuated, Leningrad's regional governor said.The official confirmed a cargo vessel bound for Kaliningrad was attacked by two drones in neutral waters in the Gulf of Finland.Now

article.title: Ukrainian Air Force details overnight Russian attack: around 100 missiles and 400 drones
article.summary: Moscow deployed ships firing Kalibr weapons alongside Kh-101s, ballistic munitions and 120 jet-powered UAVs, targeting Ukrainian power facilities and crossings.

article.title: Russia Launches Another Attack On Kryvyi Rih, Fire Breaks Out At Industrial Facility - Menafn
article.summary: Russia Launches Another Attack On Kryvyi Rih, Fire Breaks Out At Industrial FacilityMenafn

source.name: MENA FN (Middle East North Africa Financial Network)

article.title: Two killed, four injured in Russian attack on railway station in Lviv
article.summary: Two people were killed and at least four others injured in a Russian attack on Lviv this morning.

article.title: Number of people injured in strikes on central Kryvyi Rih rises to 58, including six children
article.summary: A 20-year-old paramedic and a seven-year-old boy were killed in Russian strikes on Kryvyi Rih. Eleven people remain in a serious condition, while dozens of buildings and emergency vehicles have been damaged.

article.title: Russian Morning Attack on Kyiv Injures 2 Men, Damages Homes
article.summary: A Russian morning aerial attack on Kyiv injured two men aged 63 and 67 – one of whom was hospitalized – and damaged private residential buildings across the Podil, Holosiivskyi, and Solomianskyi districts on Saturday, Nov. 21, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko and city police reported.

article.title: Russian Missiles Kill 6, Wound 17 in Kyiv, Disrupt Power, Water Supply
article.summary: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv on Nov. 20 killed six people and injured at least 17. The attacks damaged bridges and critical infrastructure, disrupted electricity and water supplies, and caused major traffic disruptions across the capital.

article.title: Two injured by falling Russian drone debris in Kyiv
article.summary: Two houses caught fire in Kyiv following a Russian attack on 21 November, as the city faced simultaneous missile and drone threats after several overnight air-raid warnings.

article.title: Russia launches another attack on Kryvyi Rih, fire breaks out at industrial facility
article.summary: Russian forces have launched another drone attack on Kryvyi Rih, sparking a fire at an industrial facility.

article.title: Russia launches ballistic missile attack on central Kryvyi Rih: child and paramedic killed, at least 21 injured
article.summary: Russian forces attacked the centre of Kryvyi Rih with ballistic missiles on the evening of 20 November, injuring at least 21 people. A seven-year-old boy and a female paramedic have been killed in the attack.

article.title: Missile War Monitor: Russian double-tap on a Kryvyi Rih restaurant kills a paramedic and a boy of seven
article.summary: bne IntelliNewsA Russian double-tap on a Kryvyi Rih restaurant killed an ambulance paramedic and a boy of seven and injured 58 people, six of them children.

article.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times since evening: Two killed, 55 injured
article.summary: Since the evening of November 20, Russian forces have attacked five districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region nearly 10 times using drones and missiles. Two people were killed and 55 injured. Children were among both the victims and the injured.

article.title: Drones attack cargo ship heading to Russia's Kaliningrad in Gulf of Finland
article.summary: Two drones have attacked a cargo ship heading to Russia's Kaliningrad in the Gulf of Finland.

article.title: 'Despicable' —Russian double-tap attack in Kryvyi Rih kills 7-year-old and paramedic, injures 52
article.summary: The deadly strikes targeted a densely populated urban area full of civilians on World Children's Day, Kryvyi Rih Defense Council Head Oleksandr Visual said.

article.title: Three killed, 15 injured in Russian attack on Kyiv
article.summary: Three people have been killed and 15 injured in a Russian missile attack on Kyiv.

article.title: Russian Drone Strike on Kharkiv Region Apartment Block Injures 11
article.summary: A Russian strike drone hit a five-story residential apartment building in the settlement of Solonytsivka in Ukraine’s Kharkiv region, injuring 11 people – including two children – and sparking a 250-square-meter fire across the fourth, fifth, and technical floors, the State Emergency Service (DSNS)

article.title: Russian cargo ship on fire in Gulf of Finland after reported drone strike
article.summary: A fire broke out aboard the Russian dry cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday morning, with Russian officials claiming the vessel was struck by two drones.

article.title: Russian ballistic missile strike on Ukraine’s Kryvyi Rih injures 20, including three children
article.summary: Russian forces struck Kryvyi Rih on the evening of November 20. Oleksandr Hanzha, the head of the Dnipropetrovsk regional administration, said a restaurant, garages, and cars were damaged in the city.

article.title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kyiv rises to six, 15 injured
article.summary: The death toll from Russia's overnight attack on Kyiv has risen to six.

article.title: Russian Strike on Kryvyi Rih Wounds 58, Kills 7-Year-Old and Paramedic
article.summary: A Russian ballistic missile strike on central Kryvyi Rih, a city in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region, on Friday evening, Nov. 20, killed a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old paramedic and injured 58 people, including four children, local officials said.
